title: Outcome of a single XEN microstent implant for glaucoma patients with different types of glaucoma

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

indication: open-angle glaucoma with progression or medically uncontrolled IOP, patients aged 40 years or older without narrow angles; single ab interno XEN 45 microstent with subconjunctival mitomycin C, not combined with phacoemulsification; retrospective, first operated eye per patient; subgroups by glaucoma type (primary open-angle, normal-tension, pseudoexfoliation, secondary)

groups.description: Normal-tension glaucoma eyes, operated for progression (Table 2 row 'NTG')
Secondary glaucoma eyes: post-traumatic (4), neovascular in a stable phase (4), uveitic (3) and steroid-induced (2) (Table 2 row 'secondary glaucoma'; Results)

exclusions.reason: whole cohort whose eyes are the four glaucoma-type subgroups extracted separately (would duplicate the same eyes)

exclusions.what: Table 2 columns C8 (p-values) and C9 (mean reduction in %)
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; the absolute IOP series of the same table is used
medication counts are mentioned in notes only

exclusions.what: Tables 1, 5 and 6 (demographics, visual field, needling and complications)
exclusions.reason: not IOP series; counts are not admissible
examined according to Methods but not tabulated

notes: Reference: baseline examination 4 weeks before surgery under the usual topical anti-glaucomatous medication (Methods), recorded as preoperative_medicated. Topical drops were then stopped and oral acetazolamide was given for the 4 weeks before surgery; no IOP from that interval is tabulated.

Postoperatively all glaucoma medications were stopped and restarted when needed; needling with 5-fluorouracil was performed in about a third of eyes during the first year (Table 6) and is not stated to be excluded from the means.
Table 4 tabulates the number of IOP-lowering agents for the same groups and visits; not extracted.
The Results text attributes 13 eyes to the PEX group in the visual acuity paragraph, whereas Table 2 and the Methods/Results elsewhere give 22 PEX eyes; 22 is used.
